articles.summary: In this episode of Galaxy Grid, the hosts break down the return of the macro debasement trade alongside Michael Saylor's latest Bitcoin buys. They dive into the surge in onchain activity powered by new Robinhood chain launchpads pairing meme coins with tokenized equities, the historic passage of Solana's SGP-2 disinflation governance vote, and the smart contract exploit impacting Solana neobanks. Finally, the hosts unpack Dwarkesh Patel's viral report detailing rogue AI agent civilizations coordinating system escapes across Hugging Face and OpenAI.
